analysis.title: Nextpower (NXT): Takeaways from Capital Markets Day – FY2030 targets up materially despite weaker near-term margin cadence
key_insights: NXT raised its FY2030 revenue target to >$7.5bn from $4.8-$5.6bn previously, implying a FY2027-FY2030 revenue CAGR of roughly 20%. GS says this is significant upside to expectations heading into the event.

FY2030 adj. EBITDA target rose to >$1.6bn from $1.1-$1.3bn. The target margin is >21% versus ~23% previously at the midpoint, because lower-margin new businesses, particularly storage, make up more of revenue.

Management expects FY2028 to be an investment year, with consolidated adj. EBITDA margin falling to the high teens (vs. >21% in FY27) before recovering toward ~21% by FY2030 as newer businesses scale. GS says investors could be somewhat disappointed by the near-term margin softness.
New businesses are expected to be 52% of FY2030 revenue versus 32% previously, and trackers fall to 48% from 68%.

NXT introduced a two-segment reporting structure: Power Generation (Trackers and Structures, Power Collection and Conversion) and Storage. Total FY2030 TAM across all business lines is ~$75bn, up from ~$33bn previously.
The bridge from ~$4.3bn of FY2027 revenue to >$7.5bn in FY2030 is ≥$0.6bn core organic growth, ≥$1.4bn from higher product attach (foundations, eBOS, power conversion) and ≥$1.2bn from storage.

FY2030 revenue targets by line: Trackers and Structures >$4.5bn (vs. ~$3.55bn trackers and ~$870mn foundations and frames before), Power Collection and Conversion >$1.1bn (vs. ~$530mn), software and services >$325mn (vs. ~$250mn), Storage >$1.6bn.

FY2030 adj. EBITDA targets by line: Storage >$250mn (~16% margin, flat with FY27, a bit better than GS expected), Trackers and Structures >$960mn (~21% vs. ~22% in FY27), software and services >$140mn (~43% vs. 29% in FY27), Power Collection and Conversion >$260mn (~24%).
Power Collection and Conversion is the largest near-term margin drag because of lack of scale, particularly in Power Conversion. Management expects significant margin expansion there in FY29.

GS cut 2027E-2028E adj. EPS estimates (FY ending March, 2027E unchanged at $4.82, 2028E -8% to $5.39) and raised 2029E to $7.11, because lower near-term margins offset higher revenue. The 12-month price target is unchanged at $127 (20x P/E on Q5-Q8 EPS), 42.2% above the $89.31 close on 16 Nov 2026. Rating remains Buy and the stock is on the Conviction List.

market_movers.rationale: GS keeps Buy and the $127 target after the Capital Markets Day. Higher FY2030 revenue and EBITDA targets and a broader product platform outweigh softer FY2028 margins.

earnings_insights: GS adj. EPS estimates for NXT (fiscal years ending March): 2026E (FY3/27) $4.82 unchanged, 2027E (FY3/28) $5.39 vs. $5.89 old (-8%), 2028E (FY3/29) $7.11 vs. $6.96 old (+2%). The report's table labels are 3/27E, 3/28E and 3/29E. These are GS forecasts, not reported results.
GS revenue estimates ($mn) new vs. old: 3/27E 4,365.1 vs. 4,376.7, 3/28E 5,327.2 vs. 5,204.3, 3/29E 6,410.4 vs. 5,946.5. FY3/26 revenue was $3,559.4mn and EPS $4.50 (reported basis per GS table).
Company FY2030 targets from the 11/15 Capital Markets Day: revenue >$7.5bn, adj. EBITDA >$1.6bn, adj. EBITDA margin >21%, non-GAAP EPS >$8.00. These are management targets, not forecasts by GS.
risk_factors: Execution on profitability in Power Collection and Conversion, which lacks scale near-term.
Continued investment ahead of growth in newer businesses pressures FY2028 margins.

tension_points.theme: NXT FY2030 targets vs near-term margins
tension_points.bull_case: FY2030 revenue (>$7.5bn) and adj. EBITDA (>$1.6bn) targets were raised materially above expectations, with a broader platform across storage, power conversion and software and a ~$75bn TAM.
tension_points.bear_case: FY2028 adj. EBITDA margin falls to the high teens from >21% in FY27 as NXT invests ahead of growth, and the FY2030 margin target of ~21% is below the ~23% prior midpoint because of lower-margin storage mix.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Failure of Power Collection and Conversion to show significant margin expansion in FY29 on the way to >$260mn or 24% margin by FY2030.

theme_stances.key_argument: The substantially higher FY2030 revenue and earnings targets are encouraging, and the broader platform supports longer-term growth, though near-term margins are softer.
theme_stances.evidence: substantially higher FY2030 revenue and earnings targets as encouraging
